title: SAM_X_012_FALSIFIER_HUNT

subject_negative_prediction.why_forbidden: Both parts 7 and 5 are radix-wall parts in {5, 7, 10, 11} which are NOT in the partition algebra {alpha_H^i * D^j : product <= R} = {1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 12}

decoded_observable_signature.candidate_charge_set_rationale: Following the SAM-X pattern (Q_native = +/- (signed sum of partition parts) / R = +/- k/12), the (7,5) partition would generate charges built from the parts {7, 5} divided by R=12. The set { +/-7/12, +/-5/12, +/-1/6 } covers all sign combinations of single-block screen and mixed-block lift. None of these are in the SM rational-charge set {0, +/-1/3, +/-2/3, +/-1}.

mass_band_MeV.rationale: SAM-X-006 ((8,4) layered at a=4 PROPAGATION) = 1.025 MeV; SAM-X-007 ((9,3) paired transition at a=4) = 1.537 MeV; SAM-X-008 ((6,4,2) mixed layered at a=4) = 228 MeV. A (7,5) at the same a=4 PROPAGATION default would land in this 1 MeV - few GeV bracket. Extended upper bound to 10 GeV for conservative search coverage.

decoded_observable_signature.spin_expectation: half-integer winding plausible (alpha_H_half by analogy to SAM-X-006/007); spin is not load-bearing for the falsifier criteria

primary_CERN_probe.experiment: MoEDAL (Monopole and Exotics Detector at the LHC)
primary_CERN_probe.location: LHC Interaction Point 8 (shared cavern with LHCb)
primary_CERN_probe.sensitivity_mechanism: (Z/beta)^2 ionization signature in Nuclear Track Detectors (NTDs)
primary_CERN_probe.current_run_status: Run 1 + Run 2 data published; Run 3 ongoing as of 2026-06; MoEDAL-MAPP extension commissioning
published_searches_related: magnetic monopole searches (multiple Run-1 and Run-2 publications)
fractionally charged particle limits at Q = 1/3 and 2/3
primary_CERN_probe.gap_relative_to_SAM_X_012: No published MoEDAL search at Q = +/- 7/12, +/- 5/12, or +/- 1/6 in the 1 MeV - 10 GeV mass band. A re-analysis of existing Run-1 + Run-2 NTD data at these specific (Q, M) coordinates would constitute a direct falsifier test.

secondary_CERN_probes.experiment: CMS Heavy Stable Charged Particle (HSCP) search
secondary_CERN_probes.gap: standard HSCP analysis threshold typically above 10s of GeV; dedicated low-mass extension would be needed to reach SAM-X-012 band
has reported limits on doubly-charged scalar bosons; not yet at Q = +/- 5/12 or 7/12 wedge
adds scintillator + active calorimeter; sensitivity extends to longer-lived neutral and charged exotics; in commissioning; strongest near-term probe of SAM-X-012's mass band

falsifier_criteria.CRITERION_A: charge Q observed in { -7/12, -5/12, +5/12, +7/12, -1/6, +1/6 } at measurement-level precision
falsifier_criteria.CRITERION_B: mass M observed in [1 MeV, 10 GeV] band
falsifier_criteria.CRITERION_C: identified as a primary carrier (not a composite, bound state, or threshold artefact)
falsifier_criteria.verdict_if_all_three_met: SAM_X_012_FALSIFIED -> SAM partition-algebra commitment (PR section 2.4) broken; 09a structural foundation needs repair

anti_motivated_padding_rules.rule_1: The candidate charge set is fixed at seal time. Adding new charges after CERN publishes is a protocol violation.
anti_motivated_padding_rules.rule_2: The mass band is fixed at seal time. Narrowing or widening after CERN publishes is a protocol violation.
anti_motivated_padding_rules.rule_3: CRITERION C (primary carrier) is required - SAM cannot escape falsification by claiming a found state is 'really a composite'. The criterion is locked at seal.
anti_motivated_padding_rules.rule_4: If MoEDAL or any CERN program publishes a result that meets criteria A+B+C, the appeal row records SAM_X_012_FALSIFIED with the publication reference. No reinterpretation.

open_debts_declared_at_CR099: Falsifier signature sha256 sibling will be written by the runner.

Per-criterion measurement-level precision threshold for CRITERION A may need tightening as MoEDAL Q-resolution improves; current criterion uses 'measurement-level precision' as cited in the publication.
Mass band upper bound of 10 GeV is conservative; SAM's structural argument bounds the layered-set lift below ~few GeV but the runner uses 10 GeV for analyst-friendly coverage.

When CERN publishes any near-match (Q close to but not exactly in the candidate set; mass at the band edge), CR099a appeal row records the partial-match and the implications; original CR099 row remains immutable.
